sentences.en: I understand there has been a recent vacancy in your store.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们店里最近有一个空位。

sentences.en: His resignation left a vacancy in the cabinet.
sentences.zh: 他的辞职在内阁留下了一个空缺。

sentences.en: We don't have a vacancy at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我们目前没有空房间可供出租。

senses.zh: 空房间 - 空虚；空白 - 空缺；空职；空额 - (心灵的)空虚；失神，心不在焉
